preconditions.description: The length of the strings s and t is between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.
The length of string s is exactly n.
The length of string t is exactly n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in s)
preconditions.description: String s consists only of the characters '0' and '1'.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in t)
preconditions.description: String t consists only of the characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 indicating impossibility or a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of operations.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if not can_convert(s, t) else True
postconditions.description: The output is -1 if it is impossible to convert s to t; otherwise, it is a valid number of operations.
